strings.zh: 下面是自行车道{SCROLL}乘着自行车飞翔！{NEWLINE}享受飞奔下坡的乐趣吧！
strings.en: The Cycling Road starts here!{SCROLL}Enjoy coasting downhill on{NEWLINE}your Bicycle!

strings.zh: 自从暴走族被赶走之后,{NEWLINE}我就敢偷偷溜进自行车道玩了。{CLEAR}不过你可别跟入口的大叔告发我啊。{CLEAR}作为封口费,这个就送给你吧。
strings.en: Ever since the bike gang got chased{NEWLINE}off, I’ve been sneaking onto the Cycling{CLEAR}Road to play.{SCROLL}But don’t tell the man at the entrance{NEWLINE}on me, okay?{SCROLL}Here, take this as hush money.

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,能来这边玩真开心！
strings.en: Heh heh, it’s so much fun getting to{NEWLINE}play over here!
